rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone who lacks courage or is cowardly.

example.english: They're so cowardly they won't even go into a haunted house.
example.traditional: 佢咁膽小，連鬼屋都唔敢入。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gam3 daam2 siu2 lin4 gwai2 uk1 dou1 m4 gam2 jap6

rows.note: Use this colloquial choice when stressing that someone has no guts or nerve.

example.english: I'm really too cowardly to drive alone at night.
example.traditional: 我真係冇膽一個人夜晚揸車。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zan1 hai6 mou5 daam2 jat1 go3 jan4 je6 maan5 zaa1 ce1
